NTFS.subject: Computer & IT
NTFS.question: The _____ was Proprietary file system developed by Microsoft.
NTFS.fact: NT File System (NTFS) is a proprietary journaling file system developed by Microsoft in the 1990s. NTFS adds several features that FAT and HPFS lack, including: access control lists (ACLs); filesystem encryption; transparent compression; sparse files; file system journaling and volume shadow copy, a feature that allows backups of a system while in use.

Because Microsoft disagreed with IBM on many important issues, they eventually separated; OS/2 remained an IBM project and Microsoft worked to develop Windows NT and NTFS.
